BasicProjectile.name: Basic Projectile
BasicProjectile.description: A simple projectile that moves in a straight line and can damage targets on contact.

BasicPropellant.name: Basic Propellant
BasicPropellant.description: A basic gunpowder propellant that provides a moderate amount of thrust to projectiles.

BasicCasing.name: Basic Casing
BasicCasing.description: A standard casing that holds the propellant and projectile together.

ScatterProjectile.name: Scatter Projectile
ScatterProjectile.description: A projectile that splits into four smaller projectiles upon firing, increasing the area of effect, but reducing damage per fragment.

EnemyProjectile.name: Enemy Projectile
EnemyProjectile.description: [Internal Only] A projectile fired by enemies, which may have different properties such as speed, damage, or special effects.

HomingCasing.name: Homing Casing
HomingCasing.description: A casing that allows the projectile to home in on targets, increasing accuracy but potentially reducing speed.
